hooks.name: devlog-after-task
hooks.description: After each spec task, append a DEVLOG.md entry describing what Kiro did. This becomes the 'How Kiro was used' write-up for Devpost.

action.prompt:
A spec task just finished. Append an entry to DEVLOG.md (create it if missing) using this format:

## <YYYY-MM-DD> — Task <number>: <title>
- What was built: <1-3 bullets>
- Kiro features used: <spec task / steering file(s) that shaped it / hooks that fired / sub-agent review / property-based tests>
- What Kiro caught or decided: <tests that failed then passed, review findings, design trade-offs>
- Time saved vs. doing it by hand (rough): <estimate>

Keep it factual and short. Do not rewrite older entries.
